layer_limitations.CT: Admission activation is mocked locally; ACTIVATED_CALLERS remains off. Disposable-history controls are not a historical scan. A Python state test alone does not establish every TypeScript/display path.
layer_limitations.ID: Synthetic chain/residue arrays and structure bytes; matrix/viewer fixtures are not model-inference or rendered molecular-engine accuracy evidence. Separate PDB/mmCIF controls do not alone prove all equivalent-file pairings.
layer_limitations.FA: Pinned producer-shaped synthetic tensors; no sampling model runs. Caller policy transport/admission fixtures do not authorize held caller activation or establish mutation-guidance ingestion.
layer_limitations.FL: Synthetic CSV/NPZ/filter inputs. Selected threshold tests must be checked against every requested criterion; zero-bound controls alone do not prove a full below/equal/above matrix. Native ranking means software native-dialect data, not inference.
layer_limitations.CA: Disposable SQLite and synthetic manifest/filter publication; no live finalization or historical repair. Terminal-policy coverage is limited to explicitly exercised owners and race branches.
layer_limitations.PR: Synthetic bound scalar evidence. API numeric availability is covered by source selectors; do not infer complete rendered PPIFlow availability from unrelated analytics UI tests.
layer_limitations.PT: Instrumented non-model commands; no MSA search, ESMFold2 inference or OpenMM physics. The persisted OpenMM API fixture uses synthetic receipt construction unless an explicit captured receipt is provided; its UI check is not by itself an argv-to-UI chain.
layer_limitations.MC: Sealed native parser/export definitions and synthetic PDBs execute without models; PyRosetta physics is injected. Coverage/formula/frame transport is software evidence only.
layer_limitations.AN: Synthetic persisted/API fixtures and mocked chart drawing/network adapters. Mounted DOM marks/tables are checked, not graphical renderer pixels, live cohorts or historical writes.
